02 / The First DayAn invitation into the firm · Everyday ethical pressure
§LawScape
BY LEGALQUANTS

Welcome to Hardsell & Firestone

Your desk is ready.
Your judgment is next.

A better way to learn the ethics of law firm life: live a little of it. Meet the partners, open the inbox, and navigate the decisions behind the work—with a little humor along the way.

Start your firm day ↗
I.

The client wants an answer.

Consider duties, competing interests, and what the request really asks of you.

II.

The partner wants it now.

Work through the pressure without losing sight of the file or the ethical issue.

III.

You make the call.

Read the feedback, develop your judgment, and build a practice of your own.

Your practice has a place.

Preview the invitation into LawScape.

Pick a playable learning track. The real-jurisdiction study sets and the fictional apprenticeship have different scopes.

Design preview only. This proposed start-page selector does not launch the game or change your save. MPRE/SQE-style questions are original study material, not official exam sets.

A wider world of ethics.

The ambition: learning from every jurisdiction where there is a LegalQuant.

Playable today: US MPRE-style practice, England & Wales SQE-style practice, and the fictional State of Juris apprenticeship.

Future curriculum targets: the community-informed list below is a starting point for expansion. These are geographic entries, not approved or available jurisdiction packs.

Americas

United States · Canada · Argentina · Uruguay

Europe

United Kingdom · Ireland · France · Germany · Netherlands · Belgium · Switzerland · Austria · Italy · Greece · Finland · Russia

Middle East & Africa

United Arab Emirates · Israel · Turkey

Asia-Pacific

Singapore · Hong Kong · China (mainland) · India · Malaysia · Thailand · Australia · New Zealand

Countries do not map one-to-one to conduct rules. England & Wales, Scotland, and Northern Ireland require separate treatment; states, provinces, territories, and regulators may also need separate packs. This list follows the project’s July 1, 2026 community snapshot. New packs require source and reviewer approval.

Where should LawScape go next?

Learn by making the call.

A little practice. A little pressure. A lot to explore.

1. Create your attorney. Choose an appearance and enter the fictional law firm.

2. Find your next dilemma. Open BarMail for US MPRE-style or England & Wales SQE-style study, or try the fictional firm’s writing and evidence exercises.

3. Learn from the response. Read the explanation, earn study gold, and explore your office, apartment, courtroom, and The Sidebar.

Ethics dilemmas can have in-game consequences. The new fictional apprenticeship exercises use their own feedback and reward system. This design preview does not affect the game.
